'''Spero's plant shop''' was a business owned and operated by the [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] [[Spero]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] circa [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. 

It was found in the [[Southern Underground/Legends|Southern Underground]], and it stood out in the plaza among the run-down [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]], [[flophouse]]s and junk shops. Still, it was a respected landmark, as it improved the tenuous life of the denizens, providing freshness and beauty in that dark place. Spero sold an engineered yellow fungus that filtered the fetid air, which was much loved by bar proprietors, vagabonds and poor people who were living in hovels and pipe shelters. He also cultivated gray [[stikmoss]], stretchy [[vine]]s, flowering [[tendroot]]s, as well as herbs with medicinal properties.<ref name="sotes">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Feather tree]]s were also grown here.

It served as a common meeting place for fringers who sought information, old associates who needed his help, or patients with ailments, seeking some Ho'Din herbal remedies.<ref name="sotes" />

[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]], disguised in [[Boushh's armor]], visited Spero to seek more information on [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]].<Ref name="soten" /><ref>{{Topps|set=1996 Topps Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire|cardname=Leia Visits Spero's Plant Shop|link=https://www.rebelscum.com/photo.asp?image=/sote/soteTC041.jpg}}</ref>
[[File:RendarSavesTheDay-SOTETC.jpg|thumb|left|Rendar on Coruscant]]
Later, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] traveled to Coruscant upon receiving [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]'s message that [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] was held captive by [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]]. Disguised as [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guards]], they were trapped inside as it came under attack by four armed men. Catching the attackers by surprise, [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] opened fire and quickly eliminated them before leading the Rebels to a nearby [[Unidentified Southern Underground hotel|hotel]] to plan their next move.<Ref name="soten">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref><ref>{{Topps|set=1996 Topps Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire|cardname=Dash Does it Again|link=https://www.rebelscum.com/photo.asp?image=/sote/soteTC053.jpg}}</ref>
